title: Kafka consumer trusts event.tenantId/payload; topic tenant not verified against message; ensureQueue bypasses tenant builder
test_evidence: Commit 0035ec06. tenant-consumer-guard.test.ts: 4 of 5 cases failed on the base source (foreign-tenant Kafka message dispatched; foreign-tenant Rabbit task handled; ensureQueue accepted an empty/untrimmed name) and 5/5 pass after the fix; @proctira/events 67/67; tsc exit 0
notes: Topic 4 Option A approved 2026-10-27 (owner dbn1972). Scheduled in owner-tracks batch t1-tenant-isolation-batch4. Kafka consumer records the tenant of each subscribed topic and drops (never dispatches) a message whose tenantId is missing or differs; RabbitMQ subscriber dead-letters (nack, no requeue) a task whose tenantId differs from the subscription tenant; ensureQueue now uses the fail-closed buildTenantQueue. Dropped Kafka messages are not logged (no logger dependency in this package). PR follow-up (review, non-blocking): add an injectable logger/metric hook so rejected Kafka messages leave a trace.

test_evidence: Commits 96bb9cfb, 60a4669f (review fix). routes-authz.test.ts: 6/6 failed on the base (no principal -> 200; no tenant claim / header tenant mismatch / teacher role / analyst write all allowed; token tenant ignored) and 6/6 pass after; backend-data-warehouse 144/144 at that commit; tsc exit 0. Guard now attaches to every route declared in the registration call (synchronous onRoute window, mount-path independent); routes-authz.test.ts 13/13 incl. /api/v1 and /api/v1/ mounts and HEAD; backend-data-warehouse 159/159; tsc exit 0
notes: Topic 4 Option A approved 2026-10-27 (owner dbn1972). Scheduled in owner-tracks batch t1-tenant-isolation-batch4. Residual: role string data_analyst is not in any role catalogue (data_admin/data_engineer mirror etl-access.ts); reconcile with the D2 role catalogue (#633) before topic 15 mounts the package.

title: No in-package authorization or separation of duties: one actor can request, approve, execute erasure and release legal holds
test_evidence: Commit 33ae0ee0. privacy-sod.test.ts: 4 of 5 cases failed on the base (requester approved and executed own erasure; placer released own hold; HTTP self-approval 200) and 5/5 pass after (409 ConflictError); backend-privacy 154/154; privacy live suites pass on throwaway Postgres
notes: Topic 3 Option A approved 2026-10-27 (owner dbn1972). Scheduled in owner-tracks batch t1-tenant-isolation-batch4. Done: the requester cannot approve (any transition to approved) or execute their own erasure; the actor who placed a legal hold cannot release it (409). Requester may still cancel/reject. Unmet: (1) approver != executor is not enforced because reviewed_by is overwritten by execution/retry and there is no durable approved_by column (schema change, no migration range in this batch); (2) no in-package role gate (the gateway privacy -> platform resource remains the role control); (3) DB-level self-approval CHECK lands with PRC-M204 (t2-phi-legalhold-batch1).
